content.content: 1. Necessity: listing needs the log verb for the set view it pins down — without it, listing is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Listing is where the elaboration meets the verb; the gate keeps the use sound without testing listing itself.
